name: smwgraphics-industrial-gears-pistons
title: Industrial Gears/Pistons
description:
A background featuring a mishmash of turning gears (both side-view and front-view) and pistons to add to the clock tower setting, directly from my upcoming hack Bits and Pieces. Plenty more graphics from BnP will come following the first beta testing stage, which should happen end of year.

Inspired by the Clock Tower level in Castlevania 3, but not an exact replica.
